page.layout: One column of running text. Two notes in the left margin: "Carnis re-surrectione." beside the paragraph beginning "II. RESURRECTIO", and "Et vitam æternam." beside the paragraph beginning "III. VITA ÆTERNA". Printed page number at top left. Running head at top centre. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: mera gratia credentibus remittit, eosque in filios adoptat, ob perfectissimam filii sui unigeniti satisfactionem.
Hanc peccatorum remissione immediate sequitur Sanctificatio, quæ est Naturæ corruptæ ad imaginem Dei per Spiritum Sanctum renovatio.

Hujus partes duæ sunt: I. Mortificatio Carnis, per quam vitiosa naturæ nostræ inclinatio & dispositio paulatim aboletur & frangitur. II. Vivificatio Spiritus, per quem vitiosæ dispositioni sive inclinationi boni habitus & Christianæ virtutes succedunt.
Carnis re-surrectione.II. RESURRECTIO Carnis, qua corpora nostra virtute Dei excitata, & cum animis suis unita ad vitam immortalem & gloriosam glorificata resurgent.

Et vitam æternam.III. VITA ÆTERNA est beatissimus noster status post hanc Vitam, cum nimirum in Cœlum translati, & ab omnibus miseriis liberati, perfecto gaudio & gloria, tam corpore, quàm anima in æternum fruemur.

page.notes: The printed "CAPI-" at the foot is a catchword. The left-margin notes are set in italic. The page number "10" is printed at top left in small type. No signature is visible. Scan shows slight show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.
